versos.e: Designated as one of the ceremonially clean animals to be eaten De 14:4; with Le 11:1-8
Nor seethed in its mother’s milk Ex 23:19
As a sacrifice by Abraham Ge 15:9
Regulations of Mosaic law required that a baby goat should not be killed for food before it was eight days old Le 22:27
Hair of, used for clothing Nu 31:20
Milk of, used for food Pr 27:27
